newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic jumps after resource upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic jumps after resource upgrade.

text.p: Shares in gold miner Plutonic Resources Ltd jumped sharply on Tuesday after the company announced a doubling in the gold resource at its Centenary deposit in Western Australia.
Plutonic shares were 35 cents higher at A$4.95 at 2.30 p.m. (0430 GMT).
Pru Bache precious metals analyst Geoff Bell said the share price rise was due to good drilling results at Centenary.
"The market had expected an upgraded resource estimate at the Centenary deposit but seemed to have waited for the results," Bell said.
"We had already thought it was going to be at least two million ounces, but we are guessing now more like three, 3.5 (million) could be eventually what they have there," he said.
Plutonic shares were 38 cents higher at A$4.98 at 3.25 p.m. (0525 GMT) after earlier hitting a high of A$5.05.
